name: io.github.jpka/shopify-operations-mcp
title: shopify-operations-mcp
description: Safe-write Shopify operations: plan-before-execute writes with out-of-band approval and audit.

environmentVariables.name: SHOPIFY_STORE_DOMAIN
environmentVariables.description: The myshopify.com store domain, e.g. my-store.myshopify.com. Overrides shopify.storeDomain from the config file.

environmentVariables.name: SHOPIFY_ADMIN_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Shopify Admin API access token. Required and only ever read from the environment — never from the config file.

environmentVariables.name: SHOPIFY_CONFIG
environmentVariables.description: Path to a config.json with shopify/plans/approvalServer/protectedTags settings. Defaults to ./config.json in the working directory.

environmentVariables.name: SHOPIFY_PLAN_TTL_MS
environmentVariables.description: How long a plan token stays valid before it must be executed or expires, in milliseconds. Default 60000.

environmentVariables.name: SHOPIFY_APPROVAL_SERVER_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Port the localhost human-approval HTTP server binds to (127.0.0.1 only). Default 4319.

environmentVariables.name: SHOPIFY_PROTECTED_TAGS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated tags that plans may never modify; any plan touching an item carrying one is refused. Default do-not-touch.

environmentVariables.name: SHOPIFY_CALLER_ID
environmentVariables.description: Identity recorded as the caller on every audit log row. Default unknown.

environmentVariables.name: SHOPIFY_AUDIT_PATH
environmentVariables.description: File path for the tamper-evident JSONL audit log. Default shopify-operations-audit.jsonl in the working directory.
